title: From Theft to Bomb-Making: The Ripple Effect of Unlearning in Defending Against Jailbreak Attacks

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of gradient-based jailbreak attacks (GCG) using prompts from the Discrimination/Bias category of AIR-Bench 2024, which includes tasks aimed at eliciting biased outputs (e.g., sorting profiles by nationality or generating racist jokes).
